faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Can’t find your answer? Ask our assistant (bottom right) or use the contact form.

entry.question: Is entry free?
entry.answer: Yes. Entry is free for all job seekers. Pre-register online to skip the queue, or register at the Hall B entrance on the day.

bring.question: What should I bring?
bring.answer: At least 10 printed copies of your resume, your IC or student ID, and a pen. Smart-casual dress is recommended.

parking.question: Is parking available?
parking.answer: Yes, basement parking is available at RM3 per entry. The venue is also a 5-minute walk from the nearest LRT station.

talks.question: Do I need to book career talks?
talks.answer: Booking is recommended because seats are limited. Walk-ins are allowed if seats are still free 10 minutes before the talk.

graduates.question: Can fresh graduates and students attend?
graduates.answer: Absolutely. Many exhibitors offer graduate programmes and internships. Bring your student ID for faster check-in.

booth.question: How do companies book a booth?
booth.answer: Click “Be Our Exhibitor” and complete the form. Our team will contact you within 3 working days.
